description: This file is the main entry point of a React Native mobile Ludo game, defining the app component, managing game state, UI layout, user interactions, and importing various components and engine functions.

methods.name: randomDice
methods.description: Generates a random integer between 1 and 6 inclusive, simulating a dice roll.

methods.name: startNewGame
methods.description: Initializes a new game state with selected players, validates player count, and starts the game.

methods.name: resetToSetup
methods.description: Resets the app to the player setup screen, prompting the user to start a new game.

methods.name: onRollDice
methods.description: Handles the dice roll action, updates game state with dice value, and manages rolling animation.

methods.name: onSelectMove
methods.description: Handles a move selection, applies the move to game state, and advances the turn.

methods.name: updatePlayer
methods.description: Updates the properties of a specified player configuration.

methods.name: togglePlayer
methods.description: Toggles a player's active/inactive status in the setup.

methods.name: restoreSaved
methods.description: Attempts to load a saved game state and updates the app accordingly.
